description: Book a meeting in the connected LoopGantt ACCOUNT (requires signing in to LoopGantt, or an API key); the key owner is the organizer. Every invitee gets a calendar invitation (.ics, works with Apple, Google, Outlook and any other calendar); members with Google or Outlook sync get it straight in that calendar. Link it to a project (and a task) so the team sees it there. videoProvider picks the call: google_meet, teams or zoom only when the account has that connection, custom = the link you put in location, none = no call.

guestEmails.description: Outside guests by email (needs a paid plan)

location.description: Room, address, or the call link for custom

memberIds.description: User ids of project members to invite

taskId.description: Task of that project the meeting is about

tz.description: IANA time zone of the organizer, e.g. America/Lima

name: create_meeting
